summary.text: Danielle Gregoire is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Middlesex District since January 2013 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gregoire took office on January 2, 2013, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Operations, Facilities and Security Committee, the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee, the House Rules Committee and the Rules Joint Committee.
